questions: - [ ] What are the specific rendering latency SLAs for the Fundamental Assessments report when filtering by 'Enterprise' vs 'Legal Entity'?
- [ ] Do we need to support 'drill-down' interactions in the report (e.g., clicking a Center to see underlying Products)?
- [ ] What is the exact data retention period for the 'As-of' reporting capability? (e.g., 7 years active, 10 years archive)?
- [ ] Are there specific export formats required beyond Excel/PDF (e.g., JSON, CSV, API access)?
- [ ] For the 'changes between 2 user specified dates' feature, what is the maximum date range allowed for performance stability?
- [ ] How should the report handle hierarchy changes (e.g., a Legal Entity moving to a different Center) during the selected date range?
- [ ] Should the 'Center/Market' specific views account for user entitlements automatically?
- [ ] Are there pre-defined schedules for generating this report (e.g., nightly batch) or is it purely on-demand?
- [ ] What is the 'System of Record' for the CRR Risk Distribution data if GCIP is the source of truth for the dashboard?
- [ ] Does the 'dynamic' distribution chart need to update in near real-time as scores change, or is T+1 sufficient?
- [ ] For the interface with LUMI, are there specific schema requirements or file formats (Parquet, Avro)?
- [ ] How should the distribution visualization handle 'long tail' or outlier risk scores?
- [ ] Are there row limits for Excel exports (e.g., 1M rows)? If exceeded, should we paginate or split files?
- [ ] For PDF generation, are there specific branding/watermarking requirements?
- [ ] Should exports follow the same RBAC rules as the on-screen view (i.e. redacted fields)?
- [ ] How granular should the 'permissions based' access be? (e.g., Report level, Row level, Column level?)
- [ ] Do we need to log every view/export action for audit purposes?
- [ ] Can a user share a generated report configuration with another user?
- [ ] Is there an existing Design System (e.g., OneAmex) that we strictly must follow?
- [ ] What are the specific browser support requirements (e.g., Chrome, Edge, Safari)?
- [ ] Does the UI need to support multiple languages/locales from Day 1?
- [ ] For the 'side by side / overlay' comparison, how should we handle complex nested differences?
- [ ] When rendering the framework for a specific market, do we need to show inherited Enterprise rules vs. Market specific overrides visually?
- [ ] What is the expected load time for rendering a full market framework view?
- [ ] Should the PDF download of the framework visual preserve the interactive state (e.g. expanded nodes)?
- [ ] Are there security restrictions on downloading framework configurations to local machines?
- [ ] Does 'configurable' visibility imply a self-service admin UI for managing permissions?
- [ ] Should users see a 'Access Denied' message or simply not see the menu item if they lack permissions?
- [ ] How should the 'customization request' UI integrate with the change request workflow (12.2)?
- [ ] Should the user be able to 'markup' or 'annotate' the current view when submitting a request?
- [ ] Are there pre-defined templates for customization requests to ensure necessary data is captured?
- [ ] What is the key identifier for a 'Unique Customer'? (e.g. ECIF ID, TIN, etc.)
- [ ] Should the view aggregate risk scores from multiple linked accounts or show them independently?
- [ ] How should the system handle customers with incomplete data profiles?
- [ ] When 'zooming in' to underlying factors, do we need to show the exact rule version active at calculation time?
- [ ] How do we display contribution percentages for non-linear models or complex algorithms?
- [ ] Should manual override history include the 'approver' details and timestamp visible on the main view?
- [ ] For 'risk rating changes', should we distinguish between 'System Calculation Change' and 'Manual Override Change'?
- [ ] How deep should the 'underlying attribute changed' logic go? (e.g. if Country Risk changed, do we show the new vs old country score?)
- [ ] What is the performance expectation for generating this history report for a high-frequency trading customer?
- [ ] Defined trigger types for rescoring: Real-time (Event), Scheduled (Batch), Ad-hoc (Manual)?
- [ ] What is the expected throughput for a full population rescore? (e.g. 50M accounts in 4 hours?)
- [ ] How do we handle 'in-flight' onboarding applications when a framework update is deployed?
- [ ] Should the system support 'parallel runs' (scoring on both old and new frameworks) for a transition period?
- [ ] Does a framework update trigger a new 'Assessment Date' for the customer profile?
- [ ] How do we manage 'versioning' of scores? (e.g., Score v1.0 vs Score v1.1 on the same day)
- [ ] Should the rescoring engine automatically prioritize high-risk customers first?
- [ ] What are the sources of data ingestion? (e.g., Kafka topics, Batch ETL, API)?
- [ ] How do we handle data quality issues? (Reject record, Default value, Quarantine)?
- [ ] Is there a Data Dictionary available mapping BRD attributes to source system fields?
- [ ] Specific latency requirements for data availability after source system update?
- [ ] Do we need to maintain 'Point-in-Time' data state for historical reconstruction?
- [ ] What constitutes 'high level of integrity'? Are there specific checksum or reconciliation reports required?
- [ ] Should the system flag 'stale' data attributes that haven't been updated in X months?
- [ ] For LUMI analysis, is there a preferred format? (e.g. Hive tables, S3 bucket with Parquet)?
- [ ] Does 'all historical data' imply infinite retention for analysis, or can we archive to cold storage after X years?
- [ ] How do we export the 'logic' (weightings/rules) to LUMI? As metadata JSON? As executable code?
- [ ] Should the export include the changelog of who modified the weightings and when?
- [ ] What is the mechanism to identify 'Legal Hold' status on a record? (Flag in source system?)
- [ ] Are there specific encryption requirements for Legal Hold data exports?
- [ ] Does Legal Hold data need to be segregated physically or just logically?
- [ ] How does the system handle 'Right to be Forgotten' (GDPR/CCPA) vs CRR Retention requirements?
- [ ] Detailed definition of 'Purge' process: Is it hard delete or soft delete?
- [ ] Who are the target recipients for notifications? (System Admins, Compliance Officers, Relationship Managers?)
- [ ] Can users configure their own notification preferences (e.g. digest vs real-time)?
- [ ] How do we determine the 'underlying reason' algorithmically for complex multi-factor breaches?
- [ ] Should the notification email/message include deep links to the specific customer record?
- [ ] Are there sensitivity labels required on the notification content (e.g. 'Confidential')?
- [ ] What are the fallback mechanisms if a notification fails to send?
- [ ] Do we need a 'Notification History' view in the UI for audit purposes?
